newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Northwest spot prods prices notionally steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Northwest spot prods prices notionally steady.

text.p: U.S. Northwest product prices continued notionally steady on Wednesday, in line with small fluctuations in California and expectations that parts of a major regional pipeline would soon return to service.
An official at Olympic Pipe Line said two sections of the line just north of Seattle would resume operation early on Thursday after a day of repairs.
"Our deliveries to Portland were stopped for well over 24 hours," said Frank Hopf a vice president at Olympic. He referred to the Oregon city south of Seattle.
